title: The Last Orchard
author: Wendell Zhou
blurb: Xanthe Brightwater, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
